photos.title: Forest above the strait
photos.description: Evergreens in the foreground, open water and a far shore behind.
photos.alt: Dense evergreen forest with blue water and distant hills beyond it.

photos.title: Valley in mist
photos.description: A stream winds through a green valley under low cloud.
photos.alt: A stream crossing a grassy valley between forested slopes fading into mist.

photos.title: Low tide
photos.description: Dark rocks, wet sand, and wooded islands on the horizon.
photos.alt: Dark rocks in front of a wide sandy beach, with small wooded islands offshore.

photos.title: Waterfall gorge
photos.description: A thin waterfall drops into a gorge of grey boulders.
photos.alt: A narrow waterfall falling between mossy cliffs onto a bed of grey rocks.

photos.title: Driftwood shore
photos.description: Bleached driftwood on a rocky shore beside calm blue water.
photos.alt: A rocky shoreline with driftwood logs, calm blue sea, and hazy mountains in the distance.

photos.title: Work in progress
photos.description: A desk seen from above: laptop, notebooks, a phone, and printed pages.
photos.alt: Overhead view of a wooden desk with a laptop, notebooks, pencils, a phone, and an open magazine.

photos.title: Crossing
photos.description: A man in a suit walks across an empty road.
photos.alt: A man in a dark suit walking across grey asphalt marked with white lines, seen from above.

photos.title: Open book
photos.description: An old book lies open on a wooden table.
photos.alt: A thick open book on a wooden surface, its pages softly out of focus.

photos.title: Everyday carry
photos.description: A wallet, sunglasses, a watch, headphones, and other small things laid out in rows.
photos.alt: Personal items arranged neatly on a grey surface: wallet, sunglasses, bow tie, notebook, phone, watch, glasses, and headphones.

photos.title: Watching the surf
photos.description: A figure stands on a red rock ledge as waves come in at sunset.
photos.alt: A person standing on a reddish rock ledge looking out at breaking waves in warm evening light.

photos.title: Spring gorge
photos.description: A stream runs over flat rocks between bright green trees.
photos.alt: A rocky stream bed between cliffs covered in bright green trees, under a blue sky with small clouds.

photos.title: High peaks
photos.description: Snow-covered mountains rise behind a bare rocky slope.
photos.alt: Snowy mountain peaks under a deep blue sky, with a steep slope of rock and snow in the foreground.

photos.title: Coffee mug
photos.description: A white mug with a red printed label on a speckled counter.
photos.alt: A white ceramic mug with a red label, standing on a stone countertop against a warm blurred background.

photos.title: Headland
photos.description: Flowering shrubs above a pale sea, with a rocky headland beyond.
photos.alt: Green coastal shrubs with red flowers in front of a calm grey sea and a rocky headland under an overcast sky.

photos.title: Café table
photos.description: Two green cups and a phone on a long wooden table.
photos.alt: A long wooden café table with two green cups on saucers and a phone, and people seated at tables in the background.

photos.title: Laptop by the window
photos.description: A laptop sits open on a wooden table in a bright room.
photos.alt: The back of an open silver laptop on a wooden table, with a softly blurred tiled wall behind it.

photos.title: Whitewashed town
photos.description: White houses, a windmill, and a domed church on a hillside above the sea.
photos.alt: A hillside town of white buildings with a windmill and a domed church, under a pale blue sky.

photos.title: Summit
photos.description: Hikers gather on a green hilltop under towering clouds.
photos.alt: A group of people on top of a steep green hill, with large white clouds in a bright blue sky.

photos.title: Lighthouse
photos.description: A stone lighthouse under a heavy sky, in black and white.
photos.alt: Black-and-white photo of a short stone lighthouse on rocky ground beneath dramatic clouds.

photos.title: Desk from above
photos.description: Keyboard, mouse, tablets, glasses, and notebooks arranged on a dark desk.
photos.alt: Overhead view of a dark desk with a monitor, keyboard, mouse, tablets, glasses, and a notebook.

photos.title: Wildflowers
photos.description: A woman in sunglasses holds a bunch of white flowers in a sunlit field.
photos.alt: A woman wearing heart-shaped sunglasses holding white wildflowers to her face in a bright open field.

photos.title: Golden hour
photos.description: Long hair lit from behind by a low sun over a field.
photos.alt: The back of a person's head with long hair, glowing in low golden sunlight over a field.

photos.title: Green bicycle
photos.description: A green bicycle leans against a wall of weathered boards.
photos.alt: A green bicycle leaning against a weathered wooden wall with a blue-painted door.

photos.title: Pines at dusk
photos.description: A dark stand of pines under an orange evening sky.
photos.alt: Tall dark pine trees above a misty clearing, with an orange sky fading overhead.

photos.title: Controller
photos.description: A game controller on a glossy surface, its red light reflected below.
photos.alt: A game controller seen from the front on a reflective surface, with a small red light and its reflection.
